svg.title: LAF-YOLOv10 architecture
svg.desc: YOLOv10n modified at three levels: PC-C2f blocks in the backbone, an Attention-Guided FPN neck with SE-gated lateral connections and DySample upsampling, and detection heads at P2, P3 and P4 with the P5 head removed; Wise-IoU v3 supervises box regression. 35.1% mAP@0.5 on VisDrone-DET2019 with 2.3M parameters, 24.3 FPS on Jetson Orin Nano.
svg.text: LAF-YOLOv10 · four plug-in upgrades to YOLOv10n for tiny aerial objects
